title: Minimal polynomial of a shifted primitive prime root
statement: Let $K$ be a field of characteristic zero, let $p\geq2$ be a prime natural number, and let $\eta\in K$ have multiplicative order exactly $p$ (that is, $\eta^p=1$ and $\eta^j\ne1$ for $1\leq j<p$). Regard $K$ as an extension of $\mathbf Q$ through its prime subfield [def-pc-field-extension]. Then the minimal polynomial of $\eta-1$ over $\mathbf Q$, meaning the monic polynomial of least degree annihilating $\eta-1$, is $$\sum_{j=0}^{p-1}(T+1)^j\in\mathbf Q[T]$$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring].

source.place: Chapter I, Lemma 14.5, printed p.63 (PDF p.69), displayed minimum polynomial in the proof.
